subject: Insurance
title: Cyber Attacks: The New Catastrophe
description: Learn Cyber Attacks: The New Catastrophe in one minute.

hook.text: The 2017 NotPetya cyberattack caused $10 billion in global damage.

buildup.text: NotPetya targeted Ukraine but spread worldwide. Maersk, FedEx, and Merck lost hundreds of millions each.

discovery.text: Merck's insurer, Ace American, denied the $1.4 billion claim using the war exclusion. Merck sued.

twist.text: The ruling terrified insurers. If cyberattacks aren't 'war,' every state-sponsored hack is a covered loss.

climax.text: Cyber risk is the next frontier of insurance catastrophe.

quiz.question: Why did the NotPetya court ruling alarm insurers?
options: State-sponsored cyberattacks weren't classified as 'war,' leaving insurers liable
